upcoming_earnings.thesis: Only US-based HBM3E manufacturer — every NVIDIA H100/H200/B200 GPU requires High Bandwidth Memory stacked on the die. Samsung and SK Hynix dominate HBM but Micron has a geopolitical moat as the only American supplier. 196% revenue growth YoY (coming off cyclical trough), 8.2x forward PE. DATA QUALITY WARNING: yfinance shows $864 price — verify on Fidelity before acting. Memory is cyclical; this growth rate will moderate but AI demand provides a structural floor.
